title: Team
intro: The people named for this transformation's roles, each with the role's accountability. Assigning a team role is an access change recorded in the audit trail. It is not a business approval.
unassigned: No one is assigned to this role for this transformation.
adminOnly: An access administrator assigns this role (Administration > Assignments), because it carries an approval or access right.

governance.title: Minimum governance roles
governance.intro: The six minimum governance roles of the playbook with their accountabilities (B0018). Each role should resolve to a named person or governed group for this transformation.

implementation.title: Implementation roles
implementation.intro: Supporting platform roles: those a Transformation Lead or the Transformation Office can assign here, and any other role already on this team.

members.title: Team members
members.caption: Team members of this transformation
members.empty: No one is assigned to this transformation yet.

assign.title: Assign a team role
assign.personHintTeam: Only people already on this team are listed, because you cannot read the user directory. To add someone new, ask an access administrator. You cannot assign a role to yourself.
assign.personHintDirectory: Active users of the organization. You cannot assign a role to yourself.
assign.roleHint: Team roles without approval or access rights. Other roles are assigned by an access administrator.
assign.reasonHint: Recorded in the audit trail (at least 3 characters).
assign.done: Role assigned: {{role}}. The assignment is recorded in the audit trail.
